name: A King's Genocide
source:
https://reminiscent-64.itch.io/a-kings-genocide

A series of murders is happening in the angel town of Eridu. At the heart of it all is an angel named Aracelia. Fate calls, and for better or worse, Aracelia has no choice but to answer.
The Old Guard is at His Limit. The time is near to usher in the New Guard.
The Great Horror will soon be free.

A King's Genocide is a dark fantasy visual novel (kinetic novel if you want to be technical) and is part 1 of a dark fantasy epic I want to tell about a party's fight to protect the universe and people they love from the Eldritch creatures of the Lovecraft Mythos.
